Description: ANIEZE hand-applied PATINA. Route A (recommended): undyed CRUST lambskin; paint the rust + caramel shapes with penetrating leather dyes (water- or alcohol-based, aniline type) by brush, sponge and airbrush in thin layers; mask the shapes; airbrush the indigo base around them, blending the feathered edges; fix, then seal with a thin flexible water-based top coat (matte or satin). Route B: indigo-dyed lambskin + thin airbrushed layers of opaque water-based leather pigment for the rust + caramel, sealed. NO thick paint: it cracks at the pleat folds. Recipes from the approved strike-offs
